simple.meaning: מַפָּלָה (mappâlâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “something fallen , i.e. a ruin.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַפָּלָה (H4654) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 17:1, with occurrences in Isaiah.

definitions.full: H4654. mappalah מַמָּלָה noun feminine a ruin ; — absolute ׳מ of city Isa 17:1 . מַמֵּלָה noun feminine id.; — absolute ׳מ of city Isa 23:13 ; 25:2 .

occurrences.englishText: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.
For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
